modules.name: Galaxy XR Framebuffer10 (AZJ2) (auto)
modules.author: 4uva4ek; AZJ2 port by booinspace
modules.description: SM-I610 AZJ2. 10-bit SDR colour output with locally generated shader fixes. AZJ2 only; installs disabled. Apply and remove through one GXR Soft restart. No HDR and no vendor binaries bundled.

modules.name: Galaxy XR mic gain boost (AZJ2)
modules.author: BreadDoesStuff; AZJ2 port by booinspace
modules.description: SM-I610 AZJ2. Action opens live mic gain settings with a 10-second record/playback test. 0–40 mixer steps, global or Virtual Desktop only. Installs disabled; AZJ2 only. High gain can clip.

modules.name: Galaxy XR MV-HEVC Eye Fix (AZJ2)
modules.author: AngelDark92; AZJ2 lifecycle port by booinspace
modules.description: SM-I610 AZJ2. Corrects left-primary MV-HEVC eye order in Gallery XR. Generates reviewed library copies locally; no firmware binary is bundled. Installs disabled. Enable and Action; reopen Gallery. Right-primary videos are unsupported.

modules.name: QuestLHSync Lighthouse alignment (AZJ2)
modules.author: stearnsbq and CreoleVR; AZJ2 port by booinspace
modules.description: SM-I610 AZJ2. Factory-calibrated Lighthouse alignment for SteamVR/Virtual Desktop. AZJ2 only. Does not provide native Android XR controller input. Installs disabled; enable and Action to start.

modules.name: Galaxy XR root face tracking (AZJ2)
modules.author: compdoge; AZJ2 port by booinspace
modules.description: SM-I610 AZJ2. Read-only vendor probes relay per-eye gaze, pupils, face and tongue to VRCFT-ALVR-UE. Exact AZJ2 only. Installs disabled. Configure a PC IPv4 address in Action before starting.

modules.name: Galaxy XR wear-aware display blanking (AZJ2)
modules.author: booinspace
modules.description: SM-I610 AZJ2. Turns the panel off after 60 seconds without eyes while worn; polls every 16 ms while blanked to restore on eye return. Keeps stock removal sleep. Enable then Action; no Soft restart needed.

modules.name: Wi-Fi ADB
modules.author: 4uva4ek
modules.description: SM-I610 AZJ2. Automatically start authenticated ADB TCP on port 5555. Installs disabled.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Window Controls
modules.author: BlueScorpioVR; AZJ2 port by booinspace
modules.description: SM-I610 AZJ2. AZJ2 startup experiment: no fixed SystemUI age or Borderless delay; readiness, identity and quarantine checks retained. Window controls with opt-in immersive app pins, 50 Home pins, 10x movement distance, aligned grab and resize boundaries, Action settings, curvature, borderless, rotation sliders and opt-in wrist-grab rotation. Built-in recovery and coordinated restart resume. Keep separate window modules off. Installs disabled.
